description: Test suite for category storage operations in the focalboard project, including creation, update, deletion, reordering, and category board management.

methods.name: StoreTestCategoryStore
methods.description: Main test function that runs multiple category-related tests in sequence.

methods.name: testGetCreateCategory
methods.description: Tests creating categories with collapsed and uncollapsed states, and retrieval of non-existent category.

methods.name: testUpdateCategory
methods.description: Tests updating category properties including name and collapsed state.

methods.name: testDeleteCategory
methods.description: Tests deleting a category and verifying its deletion timestamp.

methods.name: testGetUserCategories
methods.description: Tests retrieving all categories for a user and team.

methods.name: testReorderCategories
methods.description: Tests reordering categories and handling of non-existing category IDs.

methods.name: testReorderCategoryBoards
methods.description: Tests reordering boards within a category.
